lifecycle_v1.unresolved_rule: Remain active until a required missing bar raises DATA_UNAVAILABLE; never infer a terminal event from a future missing bar.

gold_oracle.rule: Earlier independent oracle; do not regenerate, replace, or derive it from the consumer.

formal_consumer.rule: Reuse this reviewed core adapter and consumer; do not reimplement momentum, volatility, NAV, turnover, lifecycle accounting, or IC.

formal_runner.entrypoint: run(data_root) after a separate approved contract-review artifact binds this exact freeze SHA
formal_runner.rule: This thin entry verifies the freeze, invokes only the bound adapter and consumer for all frozen cells, and writes exactly one result artifact.

mechanism: Cross-sectional momentum changes sign with the broad PIT-universe volatility state: continuation in calm markets and relative reversal in high-volatility markets.

formula.timing: Use completed UTC data through close t; execute at UTC open t+1; first earned interval is open t+1 to the next open.
formula.pit_universe: Use monthly PIT membership effective at execution t+1 and names active as of decision close t only.
formula.selection: Rank PIT-active names by median quote_volume over 90 completed bars t-89 through t, descending then canonical symbol; missing required history or execution open is DATA_UNAVAILABLE.
formula.momentum: For h in {7,14,28}, compute close(t)/close(t-h)-1, average tied cross-sectional normalized ranks, then average horizons.
formula.broad_volatility: For selected names, take sample stdev of 30 completed close-to-close returns times sqrt(365), then cross-sectional median.
formula.regime: Train uses expanding median of prior valid train values after eight priors; equality is calm. OOS and holdout use the fixed median of all valid 2021 train values only.
formula.positions: Calm long highest and short lowest quintile; high volatility reverses that mapping. Each leg absolute gross 0.5, equal weighted; gross 1 and net 0.
formula.schedule: 157 decisions every seven calendar days, UTC, anchored 2021-01-01. All decisions remain in one continuous portfolio across splits.
formula.lifecycle: Confirmed held terminal earns final open-to-final-close return, is forcibly liquidated with exit cost, and is never forward-filled. No terminal or final close substitutes for an IC endpoint open.
formula.turnover_accounting: At target trade, turnover is sum abs(target weight - incumbent drifted signed-notional weight) over the union, using true pre-trade NAV. Include both legs, terminal exits, and final liquidation. Independently simulate no-cost, 15 bps, and 30 bps cost paths.
formula.ic: For every preflight-admitted decision, calculate Spearman of the regime-signed momentum and complete same-name execution-open to endpoint-open seven-day return. Excluded rows remain in the portfolio path but not IC.

parameters.rule: All four are simultaneous frozen diagnostics. Primary stays (30,30); no cell may rescue it.

horizon_rules.admission: execution+7 calendar days must be strictly before both split end-exclusive and dataset boundary-exclusive timestamps; first eight train decisions are warmup and excluded.

pass_fail_criteria.identity_execution: Every identity and runtime invariant must pass and formal run count must equal one; otherwise no market verdict.
pass_fail_criteria.primary: Baseline OOS and holdout total return > 0, Sharpe >= 0.50, max drawdown >= -0.25; combined OOS+holdout total return > 0 and Sharpe >= 0.75.
pass_fail_criteria.stress: At 30 bps, OOS and holdout total return > 0 and combined Sharpe >= 0.50.
pass_fail_criteria.predictive: OOS and holdout signed mean IC > 0 and combined OOS+holdout signed IC t-stat >= 1.50.
pass_fail_criteria.regimes: Each regime has at least 20 admitted IC decisions, positive baseline compounded return, and positive signed mean IC.
pass_fail_criteria.multi_period: At least three of four frozen half-years have positive baseline return and none has max drawdown below -0.25.
pass_fail_criteria.neighborhood: At least three of four cells, including primary, are positive in OOS and holdout and have combined Sharpe >= 0.50.
pass_fail_criteria.concentration: Maximum absolute incumbent or target weight <= 0.15, largest absolute net-contribution share <= 0.20, top-five <= 0.60.
pass_fail_criteria.lifecycle: All observed held terminals use forced exits; exact IC endpoints only; lifecycle event impact / total absolute combined OOS+holdout daily net PnL <= 0.20. Zero events is permitted.

formal_execution.result_artifact: A single immutable result artifact must contain primary, neighborhood, no-cost/baseline/stress, split/regime/IC/concentration/lifecycle diagnostics and final classification.
formal_execution.authorization: No execution is authorized by this freeze alone; require independent contract approval before the one authorized invocation.
formal_execution.rerun_policy: After any formal performance value is exposed this formal ID must never run again; no mechanism, formula, parameter, split, cost, universe, lifecycle, horizon, threshold, or gate rescue.
formal_execution.result_ceiling: Price V1 is survivor-biased and exploration-only: at most EXPLORATION_PASS; PROMOTABLE_ALPHA, STRATEGY_READY, and LIVE_READY are prohibited.
